notes.title: Steam Release Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
We've been getting a lot of requests on when Starship Horizons will be available for purchase here on Steam! It's coming very soon! When COVID hit, we decided to pivot some of out efforts and make single and multi-bridge play easier for groups that couldn't play together physically.  Some of the things we've recently added include:

[list]
[*]Multi-Player Lobby! Find other people wanting to play together and Join up!
[*]Up to 6 players can connect their copies of Starship Horizons across the internet to play in the same bridge experience.
[*]Up to 24 players can connect their copies of Starship Horizon across the internet to play in the same bridge experience in up to 4 vessels.
[/list]

That work has been completed and we are just working on cleaning things up to submit it for Steam approval!!!

Keep your eyes on this space, as we will post updates as we have them!
